components.button_primary: w-full h-14 bg-[#3A86FF] text-white rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-lg active:scale-95 transition-transform shadow-[0_4px_14px_0_rgba(58,134,255,0.39)]
components.button_secondary: w-full h-14 bg-white text-[#0F172A] border-2 border-slate-200 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-lg active:scale-95 transition-transform active:bg-slate-50
components.button_google: w-full h-14 bg-white text-[#0F172A] border-2 border-slate-200 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-lg active:scale-95 transition-transform gap-3
components.card: bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-100
components.input_field: w-full h-14 bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 rounded-2xl px-5 text-base focus:border-[#3A86FF] focus:ring-0 outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-slate-400
components.bottom_nav: absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-20 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-slate-100 flex justify-around items-center px-4 z-50
components.badge_ai_score: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-[#06D6A0]/10 to-[#3A86FF]/10 text-[#3A86FF] border border-[#3A86FF]/20
components.list_item: flex items-center gap-4 p-4 bg-white rounded-2xl mb-3 active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform shadow-sm border border-slate-50

animations_and_interactions.hover_states: Use 'active:scale-95' or 'active:scale-[0.98]' extensively. Mobile apps do not have hover states. Focus on touch feedback.
animations_and_interactions.page_transitions: Implement smooth sliding or fading if a router allows. For modals, slide up from bottom.
animations_and_interactions.loading: Pulse animations on skeleton loaders (rounded-2xl) instead of standard spinners.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #3A86FF meets 4.5:1 contrast. Use darker shades for text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.touch_targets: All interactive elements must be at least 44x44px. Use h-12 w-12 minimum for icon buttons.
accessibility.test_ids: Every button, link, and input MUST have a role-based data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='approve-loan-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a mobile web app simulating an Expo React Native view. You must wrap the entire application in a centered container (`max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-slate-200`) and the inner app in (`w-full min-h-screen bg-[#F4F6F8] relative overflow-hidden text-[#0F172A]`).
Use standard Tailwind HTML (divs, spans) to create the layout since it's a mobile interface simulation. The components are specified for standard React JS web (.js).
Ensure large touch targets (min-h-12) for all clickable elements to respect Expo/mobile app constraints.
Avoid purple gradients (AI slop) entirely. Use the 'AI Credit Score' gradient defined in colors (Mint to Blue).
Include bottom navigation fixed at the bottom (`absolute bottom-0 w-full`) of the max-w-md container. Do NOT make it fixed to the browser window, fix it to the mobile wrapper.
Do NOT output a .tsx file format guideline. The codebase uses standard React JSX (.jsx) or plain .js files.
